# Recipe

_SKOS concept in the [PKM Vocabulary](../)._

A set of ingredients, instructions, nutrition, and information to prepare, cook, and eat a meal.

## Scope note

Reusable building block referenced by meals; imported into Plan to Eat and stored in the PKM Meals SwiftData SQL database, Obsidian Markdown notes, and Neo4j knowledge graph.
